Un adjudicataire qui, durant l’exécution du marché, ferait l’objet d’une procédure de réorganisation judiciaire (ou de toute situation similaire), s’engage expressément à ne pas suspendre ou interrompre l’exécution du marché (voir Art XX.56, § 1er et 2 du Code de droit économique). Succession On entend ici une succession universelle ou partielle de l’adjudicataire initial, à la suite d’opérations de restructuration de société, notamment de rachat, de fusion, d’acquisition ou d’insolvabilité, assurée par un autre opérateur économique qui remplit les critères de sélection établis initialement, à condition que cela n’entraîne pas d’autres modifications substantielles du marché. La règle « de minimis » Une modification peut être apportée au marché lorsque la valeur de la modification est inférieure au seuil fixé pour la publicité européenne et à dix pour cent de la valeur du marché initial. Lorsque plusieurs modifications successives sont effectuées, le montant est déterminé sur la base de la valeur cumulée nette des modifications successives. Toutefois, la modification ne peut pas changer la nature globale du marché ou de l’accord-cadre. Modification non substantielle Une

Der Verbraucherzentrale Bundesverband ist die Stimme der Verbraucher:innen – und damit eine entscheidende Kraft in der Politik. Wir wissen, was Verbraucher:innen bewegt und verschaffen ihnen Gehör bei Politik, Wirtschaft und Verwaltung. Strukturelle Missstände decken wir auf, benennen Verbraucherprobleme und entwickeln Lösungen. So tragen wir dazu bei, dass Märkte transparent und gerecht gestaltet werden. II. Ausgangslage Zur Selbstdarstellung und zur Unterstützung der politischen Interessenvertretung veröffentlicht der Verbraucherzentrale Bundesverband regelmäßig zahlreiche Kommunikationsmaterialien. Dazu zählen Publikationen, Social-Media-Grafiken, Flyer, Visuals für Veranstaltungen und Kampagnen sowie digi- tale Formate. Im Juli 2025 wurde die neue Marke Verbraucherzentrale mit einem überarbeiteten Corporate Design eingeführt. Grundlage hierfür ist die strategische Positionierung der Marke Verbraucherzentrale. Das neue Corporate Design setzt klare und verbindliche Gestaltungsstandards für die Kommunikation und unterstützt einen einheitlichen, zeit

ung. So können auch kurzfristige oder zeitkritische Projekte zuverläs- sig umgesetzt werden. Ziel der Ausschreibung ist daher der Abschluss eines Rahmenvertrags für Grafikleistungen mit zwei Losen. Daher werden die aktuellen techni- schen und organisatorischen Maßnahmen des Anbieters angefordert. Im Verfahren werden regelmäßig personenbezogene Daten verarbeitet. Die Vergabestelle behält sich daher vor, Bietende gem. § 56 Abs. 2 VgV aufzufordern, innerhalb einer von der Vergabestelle gesetzten angemessenen Nachfrist  fehlende Unterlagen nachzureichen oder  unvollständige oder fehlerhafte Unterlagen zu ergänzen, zu erläutern, zu vervollständigen oder zu korrigieren. Wenn die nachzureichenden, zu vervollständigenden und/oder zu korrigierenden Unterlagen daraufhin nicht innerhalb der Nachfrist bei der Vergabestelle eingehen, führt dies zum Ausschluss der Bietenden vom weiteren Vergabeverfahren. In particular, tenders and candidates should note the requirements under Articles 28 and 29 of Regulation (EU) 2022/2560 relating to the prior notification or declaration of the foreign financial contribution, where the estimated value of the public procurement procedure is equal to or greater than the applicable financial thresholds set out therein. references_experience.text: (MVVM) development pattern, where you would have to code the presentation layer by creating View Models and Views for each object you wish to display, using NOF there is only a set of default generic (MVVM) views defined by NOF and they are applied to all domain objects (models). The Naked Objects pattern was first described formally in Richard Pawson's PhD thesis which includes a thorough investigation of various antecedents and inspirations for the pattern including, for example, the Morphic user interface. Naked Objects is commonly contrasted with the model-view-controller pattern. However, the published version of Pawson's thesis (see References) contains a foreword by Trygve Reenskaug, who first formulated the model-view-controller pattern, suggesting that Naked Objects is closer to the original intent of model-view-controller than many of the subsequent interpretations and implementations. Further information on the NO pattern is available at http://www.nakedobjects.org/ . Naked Objects 2.0 The BOMi currently uses version 2.0 of the Naked Objects framework, referred to as 'NOF2', which was the first publicly available framework to implement the 'naked objects pattern'. NOF2 was originally written by Naked Objects Group and supplied to the Department under an open-source licence.

Fixture scripts can also be used within the running application, facilitating manual/exploratory testing (discussed below). The Department also provides a number of other libraries to manage fixtures. The simple “fake data” library can be used in unit and other tests to select/generate a random value for use within a test. Integration tests should not hard-code any officer user Ids, instead the “officer leasing” library allows an unused user/officer account to be exclusively used, with logic to automatically check/reset the officer’s certificates for signed recorded actions. Production code should never use system time directly, instead it should be possible to “mock the clock” in tests. For the BOMi application the “Programmable Clock” service provides this capability. Other supporting systems that make up the technology landscape include Facial Imaging Matching System (FIMS), and the General Registers Office (GRO) system. The BOMi’s scope will continue to grow in both size and complexity to (a) support the Department’s expanding Digital requirements, (b) consolidate its technology stack, and (c) continue to support new or changing legislation as it arises. The current technology platform is .NET Framework 4.x deployed to Windows Servers. The Senior Technical Development Advisor (TDA Lot 1) has acted as an independent strategic technical advisor across the IS Division, providing guidance on a range of SDLC and architecture related concerns. The TDA (Lot 1) helped product and platform teams deliver secure, resilient, and high-quality solutions more rapidly through the adoption of modern engineering practices and automation technologies. The TDA (Lot 1) role focused on shaping governance process and technical direction and procurement activities, translating complex technical issues into clear recommendations and implementation plans. Key areas of contribution included Continuous Integration, Release and Deployment, SDLC platform engineering, application security process and governance, Test Data Management modernisation, Developer Experience, contract testing, and SDLC platform architecture, particularly for the Department’s BOMi Platform. The TDA (Lot 1) also played a significant role in defining product and platform ownership models, associated team charters and enhanced IT governance approaches. In addition, the role supported various technical procurements through technical assessments.

O tratamento dos dados pessoais encontra-se limitado, nos termos do artigo 6.º, n.º 1, alíneas b) e c) do RGPD, a finalidades exclusivamente relacionadas com a execução da prestação de serviços ou com o cumprimento de obrigações jurídicas a que o ULSSM e o prestador de serviços estejam adstritos. 3. O ULSSM e o prestador de serviços assumem a obrigação de estrita confidencialidade relativamente a todos os dados pessoais de que venham a ter conhecimento no âmbito do contrato, extensiva à informação a que os seus trabalhadores, agentes, subcontratados e consultores tenham acesso, garantindo que os mesmos assumiram um compromisso de confidencialidade. 4. ip_data_security.text: The Contracting Entity intends to procure a contract for a Service Provider to provide, licence, support and maintenance for ESB’s Digital workspace Monitoring Software. ESB operates the ControlUp monitoring software which enables us to leverage modern digital technologies to gather and analyse data at every critical point of our Digital Workspace infrastructure. It also provides historical data that is very important for recognising trends and proactively addressing issues. It is proposed that the Contract will include (non-exhaustive list – high level scope): ControlUp Performance Monitoring Software The supply of software support with licensing for the existing ESB Digital Workspace solution. Maintenance for all existing software. Management of software licences/subscriptions for all devices and software modules is required. Wenn der Lieferant sich auch beim Einreichen von Offerten vertreten lassen will, muss er für jeden Auftrag dem externen Vertreter eine Vollmacht erteilen. Diese Vollmacht ist der Offerte beizufügen. Ein Lieferant möchte auf die Mittel einer anderen Wirtschaftseinheit zurückgreifen (wie im Königlichen Erlass vom 18. Juni 2017, Artikel 72§1, vorgesehen). Ein Lieferant kann einen Qualifizierungsantrag stellen und für die Qualifizierungskriterien, die Anforderungen in Bezug auf die wirtschaftliche, finanzielle oder technische Leistungsfähigkeit sowie berufliche Befähigung enthalten (3.3.2 und 3.3.3), die Kapazitäten anderer Wirtschaftseinheiten in Anspruch nehmen. Mit anderer Wirtschaftseinheit ist eine andere (natürliche oder juristische) Person als der Lieferant selbst gemeint. Möchte ein Lieferant die Mittel einer anderen Wirtschaftseinheit in Anspruch nehmen, so gibt er dies in der Frage in Teil II C der EEE an. Möchte ein Lieferant die Mittel einer anderen Wirtschaftseinheit in Anspruch nehmen, so muss er zusätzlich zu einer EEE diese Wirtschaftseinheit veranlassen, den Abschnitt „Leistungsfähigkeit Dritter“ in Anhang 3 auszufüllen. Ohne diese Anlage kann der Lieferant eine solche Leistungsfähigkeit nicht in Anspruch nehmen. Unter Punkt 2 des Fragebogens in Anlage 1 muss angegeben werden, für welchen Teil des Auftrags diese Leistungsfähigkeit in Anspruch genommen wird. If the supplier does not take timely action, it runs the risk that its qualification extension is not completed before expiry date. Infrabel reserves the right to perform an audit, if this is deemed necessary, before extending the qualification. sla_onsite.text: tytus reikalavimus ir, jeigu taikytina, 54 straipsnyje nustatytus reikalavimus dėl kokybės vadybos sistemos ir (arba) aplinkos apsaugos vadybos sistemos standartų laikymosi, kurio forma prieinama interneto svetainėje http://ebvpd.eviesiejipirkimai.lt/espd-web/. Komisija – viešojo pirkimo komisija. Perkančioji organizacija – specialiosiose pirkimo sąlygose nurodyta perkančioji organizacija. Pirkimas – perkančiosios organizacijos atliekamas viešasis pirkimas. Preliminarioji sutartis – preliminarioji viešojo pirkimo-pardavimo sutartis (jei taikoma), vienos ar kelių perkančiųjų organizacijų ir vieno ar kelių tiekėjų sudaryta sutartis, kurios tikslas – nustatyti sąlygas, įskaitant kainą ir, kur to reikia, numatomą kiekį, taikomas viešojo pirkimo–pardavimo sutartims, kurios bus sudarytos per tam tikrą nurodytą laikotarpį. PVM – pridėtinės vertės mokestis. Reglamentas - Tarybos reglamentas (ES) 2022/576 2022 m. balandžio 8 d. kuriuo iš dalies keičiamas Reglamentas (ES) Nr. 833/2014 dėl ribojamųjų priemonių atsižvelgiant į Rusijos veiksmus, kuriais destabilizuojama padėtis Ukrainoje. Skelbimas – skelbimas apie pirkimą. Subtiekėjas – subtiekėjas, subteikėjas, subrangovas, fizinis ar juridinis asmuo, kuris faktiškai vykdys numatomą sudaryti sutartį ar jos dalį ir kurio kvalifikacija tiekėjas

eikalavimus. Subtiekėjais nelaikomi fiziniai ir juridiniai asmenys, kurie tik vykdo sutartines prievoles tiekėjui, tačiau faktiškai nevykdys numatomos sudaryti sutarties ar jos dalies. Sutartis – viešojo pirkimo-pardavimo sutartis ar preliminarioji sutartis, kaip nustatyta 1.8 punkte, kai viešojo pirkimo sutarčiai ir preliminariajai sutarčiai VPĮ nustatytas vienodas reglamentavimas. Tiekėjas – ūkio subjektas – fizinis asmuo, privatusis ar viešasis juridinis asmuo, kita organizacija ir jų struktūrinis padalinys arba tokių asmenų grupė, įskaitant laikinas ūkio subjektų asociacijas, kurie rinkoje siūlo atlikti darbus, tiekti prekes ar teikti paslaugas. Ūkio subjektas, kurio pajėgumais remiamasi – fizinis ar juridinis asmuo, kurio pajėgumais tiekėjas remiasi pagal VPĮ 49 straipsnį, kad atitiktų kvalifikacijos reikalavimus. Ūkio subjektais, kurių pajėgumais remiamasi, nelaikomi fiziniai ir juridiniai asmenys, kurie tik vykdo sutartines prievoles tiekėjui, tačiau tiekėjas nesiremia jų pajėgumais pagal VPĮ 49 straipsnį, kad atitiktų perkančiosios organizacijos keliamus kvalifikacijos reikalavimus. VPĮ – Lietuvos Respublikos viešųjų pirkimų įstatymas. Kvazisubtiekėjas – specialistas, kurio kvalifikacija tiekėjas remiasi, ir kuris pasiūlymo teikimo metu dar nėra tiekėjo, ūkio subjekto, kur

punkte nurodytą statusą. Tiekėjas turi pagrįsti, kad jis, ūkio subjektai, kurių pajėgumais remiasi ir (ar) pasitelkiami subtiekėjai turi 8.2 punkte nurodytą statusą, pateikdamas kompetentingos institucijos išduotą dokumentą ar tiekėjo patvirtintą deklaraciją. Tiekėjas, ūkio subjektai, kurių pajėgumais tiekėjas remiasi, ir pasitelkiami subtiekėjai visą dalyvavimo pirkime ir sutarties vykdymo laikotarpį privalo išlaikyti 8.2 punkte nurodytą statusą. EBVPD – Europos bendrasis viešųjų pirkimų dokumentas, aktuali deklaracija, pakeičianti kompetentingų institucijų išduodamus dokumentus ir preliminariai patvirtinanti, kad tiekėjas ir ūkio subjektai, kurių pajėgumais jis remiasi pagal VPĮ 49 straipsnį (VPĮ 88 straipsnio 5 dalies nuostatų taikymo atvejais ir subtiekėjai), atitinka pirkimo dokumentuose pagal VPĮ 46, 47, 48 straipsnius nustatytus reikalavimus ir, jeigu taikytina, 54 straipsnyje nustatytus reikalavimus dėl kokybės vadybos sistemos ir (arba) aplinkos apsaugos vadybos sistemos standartų laikymosi, kurio forma prieinama interneto svetainėje http://ebvpd.eviesiejipirkimai.lt/espd-web/. Komisija – viešojo pirkimo komisija. Perkančioji organizacija – specialiosiose pirkimo sąlygose nurodyta perkančioji organizacija. Pirkimas – perkančiosios organizacijos atliekamas viešasis pirkimas. Preliminarioji sutartis – preliminarioji viešojo pirkimo-pardavimo sutartis (jei taikoma), vienos ar kelių perkančiųjų organizacijų ir vieno ar kelių tiekėjų sudaryta sutartis, kurios tikslas – nustatyti sąlygas, įskaitant kainą ir, kur to reikia, numatomą kiekį, taikomas viešojo pirkimo–pardavimo sutartims, kurios bus sudarytos per tam tikrą nurodytą laikotarpį. PVM – pridėtinės vertės mokestis. Reglamentas - Tarybos reglamentas (ES) 202

vienas ūkio subjektas, jeigu tiekėjas remiasi jo pajėgumais pagal VPĮ 49 straipsnį; pasiūlymo teikimo metu žinomi subtiekėjai (jeigu perkančioji organizacija nustato reikalavimus dėl subtiekėjų pašalinimo pagrindų); fiziniai asmenys, kuriuos tiekėjas ketina įdarbinti pirkimo laimėjimo atveju ir kurių pajėgumais tiekėjas remiasi pagal VPĮ 49 straipsnį (kvazisubtiekėjai) (jeigu perkančioji organizacija nustato reikalavimus dėl fizinių asmenų, kurių kvalifikacija tiekėjas remiasi ir kuriuos, pirkimo laimėjimo atveju, tiekėjas ketina įdarbinti, pašalinimo pagrindų). EBVPD pildomas jį įkėlus interneto svetainėje http://ebvpd.eviesiejipirkimai.lt/espd-web/. Tiekėjas, pildydamas EBVPD, laukelyje „Procedūros tipas“ turi pasirinkti „Atvira“. Teikdamas pasiūlymą CVP IS priemonėmis EBVPD tiekėjas turi pridėti kartu su kitais pasiūlymo dokumentais (pasiūlymo pateikimo skiltyje „Prisegti dokumentus“). EBVPD nurodytą informaciją pagrindžiantys dokumentai kartu su pasiūlymu neteikiami, išskyrus išimtinius atvejus, kai specialiosiose pirkimo sąlygose nustatyta kitaip. Kai specialiosiose pirkimo sąlygose nurodyta, kad EBVPD nurodytą informaciją pagrindžiančių dokumentų perkančioji organizacija reikalaus pateikti tik iš to tiekėjo, kurio pasiūlymas pagal pasiūlymų vertinimo rezultatus galės būti pri

bjektų pajėgumais tik tuo atveju, jeigu tie subjektai (jų darbuotojai) patys vykdys tą pirkimo sutarties dalį, kuriai reikia jų turimų pajėgumų. Jei tiekėjas (jo pasitelkiami specialistai) pats atitinka keliamą reikalavimą, tačiau ketina pasitelkti subtiekėjus (jo specialistus), subtiekėjų specialistai privalo atitikti keliamus reikalavimus, jeigu subtiekėjai (jų darbuotojai) patys vykdys tą pirkimo sutarties dalį, kuriai reikia nustatytos kvalifikacijos. ===== FILE: files/1146_9643344_unpacked/1_Pirkimo dokumentai_unpacked/6 priedas. turnover_financial.text: nd ist Gegenstand des Interessenbekundungsverfahrens. Die Attraktivität des Campusnetzes ergibt sich aus seiner etablierten Telekommunikationsinfrastruktur an einem dynamisch wachsenden Hochtechnologiestandort. Das Netz verfügt über eine bestehende Kundenbasis, gewachsene Leitungswege und Netzknoten sowie redundante Carrier-Anbindungen. Zusätzliche Entwicklungsperspektiven ergeben sich aus der fortlaufenden Erweiterung des Campus durch neue Gebäude, dem Ausbaupotenzial für Cloud-, Security- und UCC-Dienste sowie der Ergänzung durch ein lokales 5G-Campusnetz. Damit bietet das Campusnetz eine belastbare infrastrukturelle Grundlage mit weiterem wirtschaftlichem und technologischem Wachstumspotenzial. Die Beweggründe für den Verkauf durch die WISTA sind eine strategische Weiterentwicklung des Campusnetzes durch einen spezialisierten Provider, mit qualifiziertem Personal und dem notwendigen Knowhow. Verkaufsgegenstand Kabelnetz Das WISTA-Campusnetz am Wissenschafts- und Wirtschaftsstandort Adlershof bildet die zentrale Kommunikationsinfrastruktur für Sprach- und Datendienste im Kerngebiet des Technologieparks. Es versorgt derzeit rund 400 Kunden sowie ca. 4.400 Teilnehmer im Voice-Bereich und ist damit ein wesentlicher Standortfaktor für Deutschlands größten Wissenschafts- und Technologiepark. Die vorhandene Infrastruktur umfasst eine leistungsfähige Kabelkanalanlage, ein Leitungsnetz auf Kupfer- und Glasfaserbasis, mit einer Gesamtlänge von knapp 20 Kilometern, sowie ein Gigabit-Ethernet-Backbone. Technisch genutzt werden insbesondere LWL-Backbone-Verbindungen, Monomode- und Multimode-Glasfaserkabel, Kupferkabel, Kupfer-Querkabel sowie FM-Kabel mit 100 Doppeladern. Aansprakelijkheid De aanbestedende overheid kan in geen enkel geval aansprakelijk worden gesteld voor de schade die wordt berokkend aan personen of goederen en die het rechtstreekse of onrechtstreekse gevolg zijn van de activiteiten die noodzakelijk zijn voor de uitvoering van deze opdracht. De opdrachtnemer vrijwaart de aanbestedende overheid tegen elke vordering van schadevergoeding door derden in dit opzicht. De opdrachtnemer sluit bijgevolg de nodige verzekeringen af om zijn aansprakelijkheid voor arbeidsongevallen en zijn burgerlijke aansprakelijkheid ten overstaan van derden te dekken bij de uitvoering van de opdracht. Op elk moment gedurende de uitvoering van de opdracht en op verzoek van de aanbestedende overheid moet de opdrachtnemer een attest kunnen voorleggen dat de draagwijdte aantoont van de gegarandeerde aansprakelijkheid vereist door de aanbestedingsdocumenten, binnen een termijn van vijftien dagen vanaf de ontvangst van de aanvraag van de aanbestedende overheid. Veiligheid van gegevensopslag en verzekeringen De gegevens opgenomen in de verwerking of in de overeengekomen software moeten worden gehost op de servers van de gemeente (conform de gemeentelijke IT) of, bij gebrek daaraan, in een cloudhosting op de servers van de opdrachtnemer of van zijn eventuele onderaannemer. IAASA is committed to maintaining an accessible, secure and user- focused online presence that supports transparency, stakeholder engagement and the delivery of information to the public. IAASA invites tenders from suitably qualified service providers for the provision of website hosting, support, maintenance and content management services for its corporate website. The Authority requires a reliable, secure and accessible website platform which can be effectively managed by non-technical staff and which supports statutory accessibility obligations, user engagement and future development requirements. The successful tenderer will provide website hosting, technical support, maintenance, content management functionality, security management, training, performance monitoring and associated services in accordance with the requirements set out in this Request for Tender. 2. It works to ensure that data and information on Ireland’s biodiversity is more freely available and accessible for use in research, conservation management and decision-making. The National Biodiversity Data Centre is a predominantly publicly funded entity, rather than a public sector body. The Centre formally became a registered charity in November 2025. The Sizing Technology Pilot is a direct extension of this modernization mandate, seeking to apply advanced digital, computer vision, and AI-driven measurement extraction capabilities to a fundamental logistical process: Soldier and Cadet outfitting. The Army is exploring a Sizing Technology Pilot to modernize the Soldier and Cadet outfitting process by using body scanning, foot scanning, computer vision, and/or AI- driven measurement extraction to generate accurate measurements and translate them into recommended uniform and footwear sizing. This capability is intended to support personnel earlier in the accessions pipeline than is possible today, in support of a faster, more consistent, and more accurate issue experience. The scope of this requirement encompasses both body and foot scanning to modernize the issuance of both uniforms and footwear. forms_signatures.text: ment of the Army (HQDA) G-4 Logistics Initiatives Group is the directorate responsible for leading the Army’s digital transformation in logistics and Installation, Energy, and Environment (IE&E). The G-4 drives policy, governance, investment strategy, and the technical integration of logistics automated information management systems. Their strategic focus centers on logistics modernization through integrated information systems, scaling artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) analytics, and improving supply chain reliability across Army operations. The Sizing Technology Pilot is a direct extension of this modernization mandate, seeking to apply advanced digital, computer vision, and AI-driven measurement extraction capabilities to a fundamental logistical process: Soldier and Cadet outfitting. The Army is exploring a Sizing Technology Pilot to modernize the Soldier and Cadet outfitting process by using body scanning, foot scanning, computer vision, and/or AI- driven measurement extraction to generate accurate measurements and translate them into recommended uniform and footwear sizing. This capability is intended to support personnel earlier in the accessions pipeline than is possible today, in support of a faster, more consistent, and more accurate iss

l, non- contact methods and translating those measurements into recommended standard Army uniform and footwear sizes. Accurate measurement-to-size mapping — not a 3D visual try-on or avatar rendering, is the core capability sought. The Army is seeking a solution that will operate reliably across a wide spectrum of Army operating environments, minimize the training burden on Soldiers and administering staff, and be capable of integrating with designated Army data systems to support downstream sizing and issue processes. 3. REQUIRED AND DESIRED SOLUTION ATTRIBUTES. Required Attributes: The proposed solution shall meet the following mandatory requirements: • Comprehensive Scanning and Environmental Resilience: Must capture both body and foot measurements sufficient to determine standard Army uniform and footwear sizing using automated, digital, non-contact methods that eliminate manual measurements. The capture hardware must be transportable and capable of operating reliably across a wide spectrum of environments, including indoor facilities and austere outdoor settings, accommodating real-world conditions such as variable ambient lighting and physical space constraints. • Data Translation & Mapping: Must translate captured body and foot measurements into recommen

tive, requiring minimal training for both the Soldiers and Cadets being measured and the administering staff. • Security & Compliance: Must comply with all applicable DoD Risk Management Framework (RMF) requirements and be capable of obtaining the appropriate Authorization to Operate (ATO) prior to processing any Soldier and Cadet data (all captured data must be encrypted at rest and in transit). Impact Level 5 (IL5) is required prior to full-scale enterprise deployment. Pilot execution will be conducted in an isolated, test/dummy network environment. • Data Management & Privacy: Must support a defined data retention and deletion schedule that strictly adheres to Army records-management and Privacy Act requirements. • Inclusive Accuracy: Must produce accurate measurements across the complete spectrum of body types, statures, and physical compositions represented in the Army accession and training population. • Accessibility (Section 508): Must provide an accessible alternative process for Soldiers and Cadets who are unable to use, or elect not to use, the scanning solution; any user-facing digital interface must strictly comply with Section 508 accessibility standards. • Data Ownership & Licensing: Must allow the Government to retain exclusive ownership of all Soldier and Cadet sizing data as well as any vendor-generated technical or derived data. • Hardware Agility & Openness: The proposed solution must be hardware-

The purpose of this procedure is to establish a Panel of Trainers for the provision of Training Services for the Local Enterprise Office in Leitrim County Council. LEO Leitrim is compiling a panel of trainers, from which future training programmes, workshops and seminars for a maximum of a 3 year period will be selected . Applications are invited from those with appropriate skills and experience that wish to be included in the LEO Leitrim Training panel. For the purposes of this document, the term “Trainer” refers to any Applicant admitted to the Panel and engaged by Local Enterprise Office Leitrim to deliver training services. References to Tenderer, Consultant or Applicant shall be interpreted accordingly. The proposed Training Services include but are not limited to those set out in section below. The Leitrim Local Enterprise Office serves as a first stop shop to provide support and services to start, grow and develop micro and small businesses in County Leitrim. LEO Leitrim Training Services are aimed at improving owner-manager skills to assist the survival and growth of micro- businesses. As per the Enterprise Development Plan, the provision of training is a fundamental aspect of LEO supports to entrepreneurs in the county. The Local Enterprise Office cur

embers capable of delivering the services [subject to that number being on the panel]. Mini competitions will be conducted in line with public procurement requirements and t he contract awarded on the basis of the most suitable trainer and the skills required for the project/approach to be delivered. As and when additional programmes arise over the life of the Panel, LEO Leitrim will either award these programmes to the initial firm identified to deliver the programme or identify the most appropriate service provider on the panel based on availability, reliability & quality of programme / trainer based on the specific needs and by reference to the original tenders. Other Requirements Which Arise LEO Leitrim recognises that training & business needs are constantly evolving and this in turn may require changes to our training offerings. Where new training requirements are identified, LEO Leitrim may run a mini-tender among the most suitable panel members based on changing needs emerging and by reference to the original tenders. LEO Leitrim reserves therefore, the right to run a mini -tender competition for additional training programmes falling within the scope of this contract at all times. Given the strategic partnership of this service, the Contracting Authority considers the creation of a Panel as the most appropriate and workable procurement process for the provision of eBooks. A Panel constitutes a means of assessing the financial and technical capacity of a number of economic operators to whom individual contracts may or may not be awarded over the Panel’s duration. The Contracting Authority is planning to run a two-stage tender process. In the initial stage, all providers who meet the Selection Criteria included in the Qualification Questionnaire Document will be admitted to the Panel. The second stage of this competition is Contracts. Contracts will be signed by the Contracting Authority with each provider, identifying the terms and conditions including the scope of the services, costs and any other operations terms required. Poor performance will be identified and raised with panel members and may result in termination of a contract and/or removal from the panel. Evaluation Criteria for Admittance to the Panel Application Requirements The Contracting Authority is using a process similar to the OPEN procedure for the establishment of this panel, therefore, while all interested parties may apply, only those demonstrating that they have the required level of qualifications, experience and technical capacity will have their application considered. In order to demonstrate eligibility, applicants are required to provide the following information: General Information Including the following information: Name of applicant Address Key contact name Key contact email Key contact phone / mobile Website if applicable Other social media platform activities Date of establishment Insurance Requirements Confirmation of insurances in place and commitment to put the following levels in place if successful for the contract: Must provide evidence of this level of cover being in place or a letter from an Insurance company stating that these levels of cover may be put in place if a contract is awarded within one week of the appointment

It is emphasised, however, that this figure is provided strictly for indicative purposes only as there is no guaranteed expenditure under the panel. Awarding Contracts under the Panel In the case of this multi-party panel, contracts will be awarded as follows: TU Dublin will consult the members of the panel and pick the most appropriate member(s) on the basis of the following criteria: 1. The most relevant previous experience in this area 2. Cost 3. Availability Use of the Panel TU Dublin will utilise this panel as and when requirements within its scope arise. However, the Contracting Authority is under no obligation to make use of the panel. Review of Performance Successful performance will be an essential feature of work awarded under the Panel. Poor performance will be identified and raised with panel members and may result in termination of a contract and/or removal from the panel. insurance_bonds.text: EMENT OF OBJECTIVES (SOO) For Secure by-Design Space Vehicle (SDSV) Topic Area 3 1.0 Purpose The objective of this effort is to address cyber threats to national critical space missions (e.g., Position, Navigation, and Timing (PNT), Missile Warning/Missile Tracking (MW/MT), Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance (ISR), and Satellite Communications (SATCOM)) through the research, design, development, testing, and demonstration of a comprehensive Secure by-Design Space Vehicle (SDSV) system. 2.0 Background Space vehicles are increasingly recognized as vulnerable platforms facing sophisticated cyber threats. To ensure mission assurance, there is a critical need to provide advanced defensive solutions for space assets. This project aims to reduce the attack surfaces of space vehicles and implement robust resiliency mechanisms that enable self-protection and rapid recovery from cyber anomalies, leveraging Cyber-Hardened Satellite Software (CHSS) technology. 3.0 Period and Place of Performance • Period of Performance: The anticipated period of performance is a 12-month Base effort, followed by three (3) 12-month Option periods, plus 3 months for final reporting (Total 51 Months). • Place of Performance: The work will be performed primarily at the contractors facilit

entity_geography.text: ealthcare Training Services Contract or concession notice – standard regime 1 Buyer 1.1 Buyer Official name: Leading Healthcare Providers Skillnet Legal type of the buyer: Body governed by public law, controlled by a central government authority Activity of the contracting authority: Education 2 Procedure 2.1 Procedure Title: 2026 ­ 2028 Dynamic Purchasing System for Healthcare Training Services Description: LHP Skillnet is establishing a Dynamic Purchasing System (DPS) to facilitate the provision of services for the period 2026 to 2028. The DPS will provide an ongoing mechanism that allows suitably qualified suppliers who meet the minimum eligibility and quality thresholds to apply for admission at any time during the life of the system. Unlike a traditional framework agreement, the DPS is fully electronic and remains open throughout its duration. Once admitted to the DPS, suppliers may be invited to participate in mini competitions for specific training requirements as they arise. Contracts will be awarded following these mini competitions in accordance with the applicable procurement rules. The DPS will operate in line with the provisions of the relevant procurement directives and will remain in place for a period of three years. Suppliers may join or leave the DPS at any stage du

ointments; those working under a PSC or PSA that is time limited to less than one year; non-personal services contract personnel and their employees, supplied by an independent contractor licensed to do business in Portugal who provides services to other local RFP 19GE5026Q0035 – LES Health Insurance Services for U.S. Embassy Lisbon Page 6 of 21 organizations as well as to the U.S. Mission; employees working on an intermittent or When Actually Employed (WAE) schedule; Peace Corps personal services contractors and Recreation Association employees. C.1.2 Riders: There are no riders under this contract. C.1.3 Periods of Ineligibility: Employees and their dependents are not entitled to health benefits during any period of employment for which premiums are not paid. During a period of extended Leave Without Pay (LWOP) or other unpaid leave beyond one pay period, the employee is responsible for the full cost of the insurance premiums for self and dependents. The Mission will pay the premiums directly to the Contractor and will collect the full cost from the employee on a quarterly basis. Alternatively

Programme Aim The purpose of this training programme is to design, develop and deliver a training programme that build people’s understanding of self-harm and the role it plays in the life of a person who self-harms. The programme will build the knowledge and confidence of the learner to have a conversation if they are concerned that someone may be self-harming. The training programme should provide people who access it with a sense of hope and reassurance that people can build healthier coping mechanisms. Programme Objectives The training programme is intended to: Increase understanding of what self-harm is. Increase understanding of the relationship between self-harm and suicide. Build skills and confidence to engage with a person and speak openly about self-harm. Challenge the stigma surrounding self-harm Increase awareness of available supports and services Stage 1: An introduction to the subject of self-harm – communicating the ‘why’ functions of self-harm through lived experience experts. The Contractor shall report all contract sales under this contract as follows: (1) The Contractor shall accurately report the dollar value, in U.S. dollars and rounded to the nearest whole dollar, of all sales under this contract by calendar quarter (January 1-March 31, April 1-June 30, July 1-September 30, and October 1-December 31). The dollar value of a sale is the price paid by the Schedule user for products and services on a Schedule task or delivery order. The reported contract sales value shall include the Industrial Funding Fee (IFF). The Contractor shall maintain a consistent accounting method of sales reporting, based on the Contractor's established commercial accounting practice. The acceptable points at which sales may be reported include– (i) Receipt of order; (ii) Shipment or delivery, as applicable; (iii) Issuance of an invoice; or (iv) Payment. (2) Contract sales shall be reported to FSS within 30 calendar days following the completion of each reporting quarter. The Contractor shall continue to furnish quarterly reports, including “zero” sales, through physical completion of the last outstanding task order or delivery order of the contract. (3) Reportable sales under the contract are those resulting from sales of contract items to authorized users unless the purchase was conducted pursuant to a separate contracting authority such as a Governmentwide Acquisition Contract (GWAC); a separately awarded FAR Part 12, FAR Part 13, FAR Part 14, or FAR Part 15 procurement; or a non-FAR contract. Recours à la capacité des tiers Le pouvoir adjudicateur évalue la capacité financière et technique des soumissionnaires à exécuter la concession sur base des critères de sélection définis ci-avant (cfr point 3.1). Afin de remplir les conditions de sélection qualitative prévues ci-avant, un soumissionnaire peut avoir recours aux capacités de tiers, quelle que soit la nature juridique des liens qui les unissent. Dans l’hypothèse où il recourt à la capacité de tiers, le soumissionnaire identifiera dans son offre les tiers à la capacité desquels il recourt pour répondre aux conditions de sélection et joindra à son offre une déclaration d’engagement de recours à la capacité de tiers dûment complétée et signée par le tiers conc

award_criteria.text: A Commercial Solutions Opening W912CH- 25-S-C001. The Center for Army Analysis (CAA) seeks proposals for an innovative Information Technology (IT) services solution to enhance agency-wide IT and desktop support across its internally managed classified Closed Restricted Network (CRN) and its externally managed classified and unclassified network environments. Offerors shall provide a detailed narrative demonstrating their organizational capacity and a proven record of delivering effective, efficient support services comparable in scope to this requirement. The narrative must include specific examples of service delivery models, internal quality control measures, and a summary of historical performance metrics achieved for clients of comparable size and complexity. This CSO AoI seeks to solicit innovative solutions that meet the objectives detailed in Sections 1.2 and 1.3. This CSO may result in the award of various types of contracts, which may include, but are not limited to, commercially-available products, technologies, or services immediately available; commercially-available products, technologies, or services fueled by commercial or strategic investment; and concept demonstrations, pilots, and agile development activities that can incrementally improve commercial products, technologies, or services, existing Government-owned capabilities, or concepts for broad defense applications. Benefits of the CSO process and the potential for award include: A streamlined application process requiring only minimal corporate and technical information for fast-track evaluation timelines for solution briefs. As such, the data needs to be correct and submittals shall be thought out, in a logical format, and be t horough. A ‘shotgun-spread’ approach will not work. Meaning, if a contractor submits superfluous information and/or with no format or shown understanding of the items, it will likely lead to rejection and a required resubmittal of the items. The same is true if a contractor only submits a portion of the items required under a requirement submittal number (RSN). The Contractor is responsible for providing quality control of contractor and subcontractor submittals to ensure they contain all, but no more than, the items required by a part icular RSN. Reclamation will retain many, if not all, of the records in library retention for many years. This is for awareness purposes only. Corrosion testing was performed by the Geotechnical Laboratory and Field Support (GLFS) group at the Denver Technical Services Center (TSC). 1.04 REGIONAL GEOLOGY A. Most of the San Juan Lateral lies within the San Juan Basin, which is characterized by young plateaus, mesas, and dry-wash canyons currently undergoing erosion in an arid climate. The San Juan Basin is a structural depression approximately 5,000 feet deep and contains Tertiary fill resting on Cretaceous-age rocks, which crop out around the basin margins. The Defiance Uplift marks the southern and western edges of the basin and is composed of Cretaceous and Jurassic bedrock formations, which dip steeply to the southeast near the New Mexico–Arizona border. 1.05 SITE GEOLOGY A. Site geology is specific to each of the seven turnout building locations. The turnout buildings are dispersed along the San Juan Lateral at strategic locations and are within the construction Right of Way. Most of the turnout building locations are within previously disturbed and backfilled ground where the pipeline was installed. B. sla_onsite.text: onID="2.0.2">CRITERION.EXCLUSION.CONVICTIONS.PARTICIPATION_IN_CRIMINAL_ORGANISATION</cbc:CriterionTypeCode> <cbc:Name>Osalemine kuritegelikus organisatsioonis</cbc:Name> <cbc:Description languageID="ET">Kas ettevõtja ise või tema haldus-, juht- või järelevalveorgani liige või isik, kellel on volitused seda ettevõtjat esindada, tema nimel otsuseid teha või teda kontrollida, on lõpliku süüdimõistva kohtuotsusega süüdi mõistetud kuritegelikus organisatsioonis osalemise eest kõige rohkem viimase viie aasta jooksul või kehtib süüdimõistvas kohtuotsuses sätestatud kõrvalejäämise kohustus endiselt?</cbc:Description> <cac:Legislation> <cbc:ID schemeID="CriteriaTaxonomy" schemeAgencyID="EU-COM-GROW" schemeVersionID="2.0.2">c753a2c5-59e6-4970-b6eb-27224e96bf76</cbc:ID> <cbc:Title languageID="ET">RHS § 95 lg 1 p 1 "keda või kelle haldus-, juhtimis- või järelevalveorgani liiget, prokuristi või muud isikut, kellel on volitus seda ettevõtjat esindada, tema nimel otsuseid teha või teda kontrollida, on karistatud kuritegelikus ühenduses osalemise eest". Kui hankemenetlusest kõrvaldamise alus esineb, võib ettevõtja soovi korral esitada tõendeid selle kohta, et ta on võtnud meetmeid oma usaldusväärsuse taastamiseks. Heastamise võimalus on ettevõtjal juh

esindada, tema nimel otsuseid teha või teda kontrollida, on karistatud kuritegelikus ühenduses osalemise eest". BUS (Business) – majandustehingute detailide moodul, mis võimaldab edastada tehingu täpsemaid andmeid. 3. Le Programme de Résilience du Système Alimentaire en Afrique de l’Ouest (PRSA/FSRP) approuvé par les Administrateurs de la Banque mondiale le 18 novembre 2021 est mis en œuvre dans le cadre d’une approche programmatique multi-phases. Les phases I et II comprennent le Burkina Faso, le Mali, le Niger, le Togo, le Tchad, le Ghana et la Sierra Leone ainsi que les trois organisations régionales mandatées pour assurer la coordination et renforcer les capacités durables : la Communauté économique des États de l'Afrique de l'Ouest (CEDEAO), le Conseil ouest et centre africain pour la recherche agricole (CORAF) et le Centre Régional AGRHYMET (CRA) du Comité permanent interétatique de lutte contre la sécheresse au Sahel (CILSS).

sla_onsite.text: onID="2.0.2">CRITERION.EXCLUSION.CONVICTIONS.PARTICIPATION_IN_CRIMINAL_ORGANISATION</cbc:CriterionTypeCode> <cbc:Name>Osalemine kuritegelikus organisatsioonis</cbc:Name> <cbc:Description languageID="ET">Kas ettevõtja ise või tema haldus-, juht- või järelevalveorgani liige või isik, kellel on volitused seda ettevõtjat esindada, tema nimel otsuseid teha või teda kontrollida, on lõpliku süüdimõistva kohtuotsusega süüdi mõistetud kuritegelikus organisatsioonis osalemise eest kõige rohkem viimase viie aasta jooksul või kehtib süüdimõistvas kohtuotsuses sätestatud kõrvalejäämise kohustus endiselt?</cbc:Description> <cac:Legislation> <cbc:ID schemeID="CriteriaTaxonomy" schemeAgencyID="EU-COM-GROW" schemeVersionID="2.0.2">c753a2c5-59e6-4970-b6eb-27224e96bf76</cbc:ID> <cbc:Title languageID="ET">RHS § 95 lg 1 p 1 "keda või kelle haldus-, juhtimis- või järelevalveorgani liiget, prokuristi või muud isikut, kellel on volitus seda ettevõtjat esindada, tema nimel otsuseid teha või teda kontrollida, on karistatud kuritegelikus ühenduses osalemise eest". Kui hankemenetlusest kõrvaldamise alus esineb, võib ettevõtja soovi korral esitada tõendeid selle kohta, et ta on võtnud meetmeid oma usaldusväärsuse taastamiseks. sla_onsite.text: an kontratuaren «balio zenbatetsia» adierazpidea erabili da, horixe baita zuzena. Kontzeptu hori ederki zedarrituta dago lege berrian, «lizitazioaren oinarrizko aurrekontua» edo «kontratuaren prezioa» kontzeptuak dauden bezalaxe; hartara, izan ere, haien arteko nahaste oro saihesten da. Bestalde, kontratu publikoen prezioen berrikuspenari buruzko arauak egokitzen dira Espainiako Ekonomiaren Desindexazioaren martxoaren 30eko 2/2015 Legean ezarritakoaren arabera, halako moduz non prezioak ez diren berrikusiko adierazle orokorren bitartez, baizik eta berariazko adierazleen bitartez, zeinek kontratatutako prestazioaren kostuaren osagaiak islatzen dituzten formulen bitartez operatuko baitute. II. liburuan, kontratuen prestaketari buruzko atalaren barruan, merkatuari buruzko aldez aurretiko kontsulten erregulazioa sartzen da, lizitazioa zuzen prestatzeko eta operadore ekonomikoei informazioa emateko kasuko organoaren kontratazio-planei buruz eta prozeduran aurkezteko exijituko diren baldintzei buruz. Aztergai diren obra, produktu, zerbitzu, prozesu edo prozedurek zenbait baldintza betetzen dituztela berresten dituzten egiaztatze-bide berrien araupetzea zabaltzen da, eta, horretarako, hemen etiketa berriak, froga-txostenak, ziurtagiriak eta bestelako bitartekoak sartzen dira.

Letra honetan ezarritako baldintza egiaz betetzen dela mandatuaren ente hartzailearen urteko kontuetan islatu beharko da, oroitidazkian, eta, horrenbestez, kontuen auditoreak egiaztatu beharko du, urteko kontu horien auditoria egitean, kontuen auditoriaren jarduera arautzen duen araudiari jarraituz. c) Mandatuaren hartzailea den entea pertsonifikazio juridiko pribatuko ente bat denean, gainera, haren kapital edo ondare guztiak titulartasun edo ekarpen publikokoa izan beharko du. d) Mandatuaren hartzaile den erakundeak berariaz aitortu beharko du, bere estatutuetan edo sorrera-ekintzetan, mandatua ematen duen botere adjudikatzaile jakinaren bitarteko propio pertsonifikatua dela, honako baldintza hauek bete ondoren: 1.a Zer botere adjudikatzai

ontratatutako jarduerei tarifak aplikatzetik heldu dena baino.
